title: Einstein letter to FDR leads to the Manhattan Project

tellings.quote: it was brought to the attention by Einstein and and another fellow whose name I can't remember right now, but they wrote to FDR for a meeting about the possibility that Germany could build an atomic bomb.

plain: In 1939 Einstein and another scientist wrote to President Franklin D. Roosevelt warning that Germany might be able to build an atomic bomb, and that warning led to the Manhattan Project. A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas tells Michels this as history, without naming a source, adding that he cannot recall the other scientist's name.
